duas.title: Dua for Traveling
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
duas.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqaliboon
duas.translation: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have done it (ourselves). And indeed, to our Lord, we shall return.

duas.title: Entering a Town/City
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa ma azlaln, wa Rabbal-aradeenas-sab'i wa ma aqlaln, as'aluka khayra hadhihil-qaryati wa khayra ahlaha
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they cover, Lord of the seven earths and all they carry, I ask You for the good of this town and the good of its people.

duas.title: Returning from Travel
duas.translation: We are returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

duas.title: During the Journey
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda
duas.translation: O Allah, we ask You in this journey of ours for righteousness, piety, and deeds that please You.
